questions.q: Why does Average Order Value use DIVIDE instead of the / operator?
options: DIVIDE is required syntax for every DAX measure
The / operator doesn't exist in DAX
DIVIDE returns blank instead of a divide-by-zero error once a slicer filters a segment or territory down to zero orders
DIVIDE rounds results to whole numbers
questions.explain: DIVIDE handles the zero-denominator case gracefully.

questions.q: What does ALL ( DimCustomer ) do inside Total Sales (All Segments)?
options: Removes any filter currently applied through the DimCustomer relationship, including the segment slicer
Sorts customers alphabetically
Deletes the DimCustomer table from the model
Restricts the measure to only Individual customers
questions.explain: ALL strips filters on the specified table so the measure reflects every customer regardless of segment.

questions.q: What's the difference between Total Sales (All Segments) and Total Sales (All Territories)?
options: They apply ALL to different dimension tables -- DimCustomer versus DimTerritory
One is a Power Query step, the other a DAX measure
They are identical measures with different names
One uses SUM and the other uses DISTINCTCOUNT
questions.explain: Same CALCULATE + ALL mechanism, applied to a different table for a different benchmark.

questions.q: Why do Total Sales, Total Sales (All Segments), and Total Sales (All Territories) return identical numbers with no filters applied?
options: DIVIDE forces all three to match
Power BI caches the first measure's result for the others
Each ALL has nothing to strip away when nothing is filtered in the first place
They are secretly the same measure
questions.explain: With no filter narrowing segment or territory, removing filters via ALL changes nothing until a slicer actually applies one.

questions.q: Why is having three similarly-named 'Total Sales' measures a real risk, specifically in this project?
options: It causes a compile error in Power BI
It has no practical risk at all
DAX does not allow more than one measure with a similar name
This project has two pages being built quickly, making it easy to drag the wrong similarly-named measure into a card by mistake
questions.explain: Building two pages with adjacent, similarly-named measures in the Fields list is exactly the kind of mistake this chapter's later lessons dig into.
